'''Vanster Enan's Cantina (Tolea Biqua franchise)''', also known as just '''Vanster Enan's Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].

==History==
The cantina was a franchise of [[Vanster Enan's Sop House]], a cantina that was located in [[Gadrin]], on the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub celebration]] in Tolea Biqua in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a number of drinking games took place inside the cantina.
